meta.prompt: Make an inline workshop poll card asking which session to run: Prototyping (3 votes), Accessibility (10), or Animation (5). A person chooses and confirms one option. After confirmation show updated share bars and percents, their choice, and the total vote count. Add ‘Results update after voting’.
meta.text:
ChatCard "Workshop poll" "Which session should we run?" icon:"how_to_vote" status:"Open"
  state choice=""
  state voted=false
  if !voted
    OptionList =choice options:["Prototyping","Accessibility","Animation"] -> choice=result
    Paragraph "Results update after voting."
    ActionButton "Confirm vote" primary enabled:=choice!="" -> voted=true
  if voted
    PollResults options:["Prototyping","Accessibility","Animation"] votes:[3,10,5] choice:=choice note:"Results update after voting"
